WisconsinKiosk · redesign D3, E1–E3, I1, I3, I4, J4

Kiosk Checkout, Kits and Interruptions

Picking another date uses a month grid, kits become the checkout's checklist for football crew and ask before leaving items behind, discarding scans is a card instead of a system dialog, and the interruptions (sleeping scanner, Still here?) read as the canvas does. Sounds for each moment follow J4.

Side by side

Before is HEAD 4b26cccb built into a separate derived-data path; after is f84a0c5d plus the second commit's working patch. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 26.5, dark, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures.

After only (states the old build can't open)

These need fixtures added in this slice, or the old UI was a system control no fixture could open.

What changed, and why

D3 other date

Was

A native graphical DatePicker in the sheet's left panel.

Now

A month grid with 52pt round day cells and 4-column time chips; Use this date stays disabled for a past time.

I1 discard scans

Was

A system confirmation dialog, plus a second dialog before Edit.

Now

A 540pt card with a red Discard naming the tags; the hidden scanner field disarms under it. Edit goes straight to details (scans stay). Pickup and return have no discard: their scans commit as they happen.

E1–E3 kits

Was

A pull-down kit menu for everyone; remaining kit items listed after the scans; checkout went through with kit items unscanned.

Now

Football crew only; a two-panel chooser; the kit is the checklist; an amber card asks before checking out without kit items. Labels are the kit's own name.

I3 scanner asleep

Was

Amber text under the scan target.

Now

A grey pill replaces the target on checkout, pickup, and return.

I4 still here?

Was

Generic copy and a bar.

Now

Ring with seconds, the person's first name, and the real 20-minute retention in the copy; two pings when it appears.

J4 sound and motion

Was

Only a rejection tone; Reduce Motion removed some animations outright.

Now

KioskFeedbackSound accept / reject / undo / done / badge / attention / warning, each tied to a visible twin; Reduce Motion movements are 150 ms fades (button press scale stays off).

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk on a created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 simulator: BUILD SUCCEEDED
  • npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- tests/ios-system-quality-contract.test.ts tests/ios-api-contract.test.ts: 23 files, 121 tests passed
  • git diff --check clean

Things to know

  • Sound is unverified: simulator captures are silent, and the fleet iPads need an on-device listen for level against the scanner beep.
  • Kit availability (Out with…, Reserved for…) is dropped: kiosk/kits has no status field (class b).
  • The football-crew gate is a heuristic (server kit suggestion or an FB shift); there is no crew field on the kiosk user.
